content:
Marina Sato: Hi everyone! I'm Marina (she/her) — joining as a Product Solutions Engineer. Moved from Seattle, big boba fan and I have a tiny corgi who is my unofficial onboarding buddy. Desk is 4E by the big ficus. Any recs for boba spots or good dog-walk routes near the office? :wave:

Jin Park: Welcome Marina!! :tada: TeaTown (2 blocks east) is our go-to for brown sugar boba. For walks the river path on 11th is great and usually a few coworkers bring dogs around 4pm. Also we have a #doggos channel if you want puppy pics.

Kaitlyn: hey marina — ops here. If your desk is 4E you’re on the corner row. Ping me when you get a sec and I’ll bring a spare USB-C dongle. If you need badge help, follow the kiosk flow: `badge kiosk -> select Access -> Request 1-day` and IT will approve. Also friday is plant-swap in the pantry :seedling:

Marina Sato: Thanks so much!! I’ll stop by IT after lunch to grab the badge. Bringing a tiny philodendron for the swap tomorrow :)

Rebecca Kim: Welcome!! We do a quick meet-and-greet in the pantry at 3pm today — come by if you can. Also we place a group lunch order at 12:15 daily, DM me if you want to join. :coffee:

hr-bot: Friendly reminder: please complete your benefits enrollment form within 48 hours at https://okta.company/onboard. If you have questions, DM @rebecca kim. :page_facing_up:

Jin Park: also FYI the espresso machine got new beans this week — very dangerous. :coffee:

Marina Sato: Awesome, see you all later today! Excited to meet everyone and trade plant tips (and boba recs). :smile:
